**Deviations:** 1 (Phase 4): every list a typed query is picked from ranks by score; a view and the folder tree keep their order. 2 (Phase 8): the delete records each target's delete-time path beside its id and the restore's repair asks `respell` with it; the rewriter leaves a link differing from its mapped spelling by `.md` alone as written, and a rename still writes without it (A-5).

**The neutral gate's answer** (`fable-high`, given only the range and the intention): every clause of the intention holds, with the function and the pin named for each; "I would inherit this as designed."

**Open items that remain the owner's:** under the plan's *§Open Items*: un-excluding a folder re-spells every collision it lands; a key two trashed pages answer in one bundle parks nowhere; a case-only rename of a target is followed on a restored page while a link written in another case stays; an unparseable Contexts registry owes the tile sweep nothing; a Set restored with an ID-less page isn't listed for stamping (a settle finding predating the plan); a heading rename that forces the markdown form un-embeds; a Text value that is exactly one unresolved link seats on one click; a page dragged out of `.trash` in Finder is an arrival, not a restore.

```/Core/Actions/blockMenu.ts diff
+/** A typed query ranks every row by its match and seats each section where its best row falls, so Enter picks the best match; an empty query lists the menu as it stands. */
+export function filterBlockMenu(query: string): readonly BlockMenuSection[] {
+  const q = matchQuery(query)
+  if (!q) return BLOCK_MENU_SECTIONS
+  const out: { title: string; rows: LeafItem<BlockMenuAction>[] }[] = []
+  for (const { title, row } of rankMatches(BLOCK_MENU_ROWS, q, (r) => r.key)) {
+    const section = out.find((s) => s.title === title)
+    if (section) section.rows.push(row)
+    else out.push({ title, rows: [row] })
   }
   return out
 }
```

##### Core/Files/rootValues.ts

```/Core/Files/rootValues.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import type { Json } from './stableJson'
+import { exactTitle } from '../Paths/caseFold'
+import { isScalar, listOf } from '../Contract/validators'
+
+/** `root` with `value` under `key`, in its place when the root holds it; `undefined` drops the key. */
+export function landValue(root: Json, key: string, value: unknown): Json {
+  const next = { ...root }
+  if (value === undefined) delete next[key]
+  else next[key] = value
+  return next
+}
+
+/** What a member matches by: a scalar's trimmed text, or the member itself. */
+export const memberKey = (v: unknown): unknown => (isScalar(v) ? exactTitle(v) : v)
+
+/** Two values as one list: `keep`'s members, then each of `from`'s that matches none of them by `memberKey`; a single value reads as a list of one. */
+export function joinValues(keep: unknown, from: unknown): unknown[] {
+  const kept = listOf(keep ?? [])
+  const seen = new Set(kept.map(memberKey))
+  return [...kept, ...listOf(from ?? []).filter((v) => !seen.has(memberKey(v)))]
+}
+
+/** Edits what `key` holds as a list; null when nothing changed. A list the edit empties drops its key. */
+export function editHeldList(
+  raw: Json,
+  key: string,
+  edit: (held: unknown[]) => unknown[] | null,
+): Json | null {
+  const list = Object.hasOwn(raw, key) ? edit(listOf(raw[key])) : null
+  return list && landValue(raw, key, list.length ? list : undefined)
+}
+
+/** `root` without `keys`; null when it holds none of them. */
+export function stripKeys(root: Json, keys: readonly string[]): Json | null {
+  if (!keys.some((k) => Object.hasOwn(root, k))) return null
+  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(root).filter(([k]) => !keys.includes(k)))
+}
+
+export type KeyCollision = 'prefer-new' | 'merge'
+
+/** A JSON root with `from` moved to `to`, null when nothing moves; the twin of `renameFrontmatterKey`, by the same collision rule. */
+export function rekeyHeld(
+  raw: Json,
+  from: string,
+  to: string,
+  collision: KeyCollision,
+): Json | null {
+  if (from === to || !Object.hasOwn(raw, from)) return null
+  const { [from]: moved, ...rest } = raw
+  if (!Object.hasOwn(rest, to)) return { ...rest, [to]: moved }
+  return collision === 'prefer-new' ? rest : { ...rest, [to]: joinValues(rest[to], moved) }
+}
```

```/Core/Nexus/settle.ts diff
+async function payOutsideMoves(root: string): Promise<void> {

+  const left = new Map<string, ConnPage>()
```

##### Core/Properties/keyFormat.ts

```/Core/Properties/keyFormat.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+export const KEY_FORMATS = [
+  'Match Title',
+  'lowercase',
+  'UPPERCASE',
+  'kebab-case',
+  'PascalCase',
+  'camelCase',
+  'snake_case',
+  'Train-Case',
+  'UPPER_SNAKE_CASE',
+  'UPPER-KEBAB-CASE',
+] as const
+export type KeyFormat = (typeof KEY_FORMATS)[number]
+
+export type FormatChange = { key_format: KeyFormat } | { value_format: KeyFormat }
+
+export const DEFAULT_KEY_FORMAT: KeyFormat = KEY_FORMATS[0]
+
+export const isKeyFormat = (v: unknown): v is KeyFormat =>
+  (KEY_FORMATS as readonly unknown[]).includes(v)
+
+const LOWER = /\p{Ll}/u
+const UPPER = /\p{Lu}/u
+
+/** A label's words: split at spaces, hyphens, and underscores, before an uppercase letter that follows a lowercase one, and before one that follows an uppercase letter and precedes a lowercase one (`XMLHttp` is `XML` and `Http`); every other mark stays inside its word. */
+function splitWords(label: string): string[] {
+  const words: string[] = []
+  for (const chunk of label.split(/[\s_-]+/)) {
+    const chars = Array.from(chunk)
+    let word = ''
+    for (const [i, c] of chars.entries()) {
+      const prev = chars[i - 1] ?? ''
+      const hump = LOWER.test(prev) || (UPPER.test(prev) && LOWER.test(chars[i + 1] ?? ''))
+      if (UPPER.test(c) && hump) {
+        words.push(word)
+        word = ''
+      }
+      word += c
+    }
+    if (word) words.push(word)
+  }
+  return words
+}
+
+const lower = (w: string): string => w.toLowerCase()
+const upper = (w: string): string => w.toUpperCase()
+
+const capital = (w: string): string => {
+  const [first = '', ...rest] = Array.from(w.toLowerCase())
+  // A letter that uppercases to two, as `ﬁ` to `FI`, keeps only the first capital.
+  const [head = '', ...tail] = Array.from(first.toUpperCase())
+  return head + tail.join('').toLowerCase() + rest.join('')
+}
+
+const joined =
+  (separator: string, word: (w: string, i: number) => string) =>
+  (label: string): string =>
+    splitWords(label).map(word).join(separator)
+
+const FORMAT: Record<KeyFormat, (label: string) => string> = {
+  'Match Title': (label) => label,
+  lowercase: lower,
+  UPPERCASE: upper,
+  'kebab-case': joined('-', lower),
+  PascalCase: joined('', capital),
+  camelCase: joined('', (w, i) => (i ? capital(w) : lower(w))),
+  snake_case: joined('_', lower),
+  'Train-Case': joined('-', capital),
+  UPPER_SNAKE_CASE: joined('_', upper),
+  'UPPER-KEBAB-CASE': joined('-', upper),
+}
+
+export const formatKey = (label: string, format: KeyFormat = DEFAULT_KEY_FORMAT): string =>
+  FORMAT[format](label.normalize('NFC')).normalize('NFC')
+
+export const spellingsOf = (label: string): string[] => KEY_FORMATS.map((f) => formatKey(label, f))
```

```/Core/Properties/optionOps.ts diff
+async function valueFormatPlan(
+  root: string,
+  propertyId: string,
+  format: KeyFormat,
+): Promise<Result<{ def: PropertyDefinition; keys: [string, string][] }>> {
+  const found = optionDef((await readRegistry(root)).defs[propertyId])
+  if (!found.ok) return found
+  const def = found.value
+  const moved = optionsOf(def).map((o) => ({ ...o, was: o.key, key: formatKey(o.label, format) }))
+  const check = validateOptionValues(
+    moved,
+    'This format would give two options the same key, please rename one first.',
+  )
+  if (!check.ok) return check
+  const keys = moved.flatMap(({ was, key }): [string, string][] =>
+    key === was ? [] : [[was, key]],
+  )
+  const olds = new Set(keys.map(([from]) => memberKey(from)))
+  if (keys.some(([from, to]) => memberKey(to) !== memberKey(from) && olds.has(memberKey(to))))
+    return CROSSED
+  return ok({ def, keys })
+}
```

```/Core/Properties/Schema/FormatRows.tsx diff
+import * as s from '@pommora/uix/Menus/frames.css'

+import { DEFAULT_KEY_FORMAT, type FormatChange, KEY_FORMATS, type KeyFormat } from '../keyFormat'
+import { type PropertyDefinition, PROPERTY_TYPES } from '../properties'
+
+const FORMAT_OPTIONS: PickerOption<KeyFormat>[] = KEY_FORMATS.map((value) => ({
+  value,
+  label: value,
+}))
+
+export function FormatRows({
+  def,
+  onPick,
+}: {
+  def: PropertyDefinition
+  onPick: (change: FormatChange) => void
+}): React.JSX.Element {
+  const row = (
+    glyph: IconName,
+    label: string,
+    value: KeyFormat | undefined,
+    change: (format: KeyFormat) => FormatChange,
+  ) =>
+    pickerRow(
+      glyph,
+      label,
+      value ?? DEFAULT_KEY_FORMAT,
+      FORMAT_OPTIONS,
+      (v: KeyFormat) => onPick(change(v)),
+      { inert: true },
+    )
+  return (
+    <div className={s.ruleFrame}>
+      <MenuIndex
+        sections={[
+          {
+            rows: [
+              row('metadata-label', 'Label Format', def.key_format, (key_format) => ({

+              })),
+              ...(PROPERTY_TYPES[def.type].options
+                ? [
+                    row('layout-list', 'Value Format', def.value_format, (value_format) => ({
+                      value_format,
+                    })),
+                  ]
+                : []),
+            ],
+          },
+        ]}
+      />
+    </div>
+  )
+}
```

```/Core/Testing/propertyWrites.ts diff
+import type { Result } from '../Contract/result'
+import type { PropertyDefinition } from '../Properties/properties'
+import { type PropertyValue, valueToWrite } from '../Properties/propertyValue'
+import { landPageValue, landSpaceValue } from '../Properties/setProperty'
+
+export async function writePageValue(
+  absFile: string,
+  def: PropertyDefinition,
+  value: PropertyValue | null,
+): Promise<Result<null>> {
+  const encoded = valueToWrite(def, value)
+  return encoded.ok ? landPageValue(absFile, def.key, encoded.value) : encoded
+}
+
+export async function writeSpaceValue(
+  root: string,
+  absSpaceDir: string,
+  def: PropertyDefinition,
+  value: PropertyValue | null,
+): Promise<Result<null>> {
+  const encoded = valueToWrite(def, value)
+  return encoded.ok ? landSpaceValue(root, absSpaceDir, def.key, encoded.value) : encoded
+}
```

```/Core/Trash/restoreScrub.ts diff
+function matchOf(words: Iterable<{ label: string; key: string }>): Match {
```

##### Core/Files/rootValues.test.ts

```/Core/Files/rootValues.test.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import { editHeldList, joinValues, type KeyCollision, rekeyHeld } from './rootValues'
+import { assembleEnvelope, renameFrontmatterKey, splitFrontmatter } from './pageFile'
+import { namesValue, stripList } from '../Properties/pageValue'
+
+describe('joinValues', () => {
+  it('keeps the first value and adds each member of the second that matches none of it: a scalar by its exact title, any other member only by itself', () => {
+    expect(joinValues(['b'], ['a', 'B'])).toEqual(['b', 'a', 'B'])
+    expect(joinValues(['Pommora'], [[['Pommora']]])).toEqual(['Pommora', [['Pommora']]])
+    expect(joinValues('Pommora', ['X'])).toEqual(['Pommora', 'X'])
+    expect(joinValues(undefined, ['X'])).toEqual(['X'])
+  })
+})
+
+describe('editHeldList', () => {
+  const strip = (value: string) => (held: unknown[]) => stripList(held, namesValue(value))
+
+  it('edits the key’s list where it sits', () => {
+    expect(editHeldList({ ID: 'p', Tags: ['a', 'b'] }, 'Tags', strip('a'))).toEqual({
+      ID: 'p',
+      Tags: ['b'],
+    })
+  })
+
+  it('drops the key when the edit empties the list', () => {
+    expect(editHeldList({ Tags: ['a'] }, 'Tags', strip('a'))).toEqual({})
+  })
+
+  it('answers null when nothing changed, and another casing holds nothing', () => {
+    expect(editHeldList({ Tags: ['b'] }, 'Tags', strip('a'))).toBeNull()
+    expect(editHeldList({ tags: ['a'] }, 'Tags', strip('a'))).toBeNull()
+  })
+})
+
+describe('rekeyHeld — the twin of renameFrontmatterKey', () => {
+  const cases: [string, string, string, KeyCollision][] = [
+    ['a: 1\nTags: [b]\nz: 2', 'Tags', 'tags', 'prefer-new'],
+    ['a: 1\nTags: [b]\nz: 2', 'Tags', 'tags', 'merge'],
+    ['Tags: [b]\nLabels: [x]', 'Tags', 'Labels', 'prefer-new'],
+    ['<Projects>: [Y]\n<Ventures>: X', '<Projects>', '<Ventures>', 'merge'],
+    ['Tags: [b]\nlabels: [x]', 'Tags', 'Labels', 'prefer-new'],
+    ['<Other>: x', 'Status', 'Stage', 'prefer-new'],
+    ['Tags: [b]', 'Tags', 'Tags', 'merge'],
+  ]
+
+  it.each(
+    cases,
+  )('answers the keys and values the page rename does for %j', (fm, from, to, collision) => {
+    const content = assembleEnvelope(`${fm}\n`, 'Body')
+    const page = renameFrontmatterKey(content, from, to, collision)
+    const json = rekeyHeld(splitFrontmatter(content), from, to, collision)
+    expect(json).toEqual(page === null ? null : splitFrontmatter(page))
+  })
+})
```

```/Core/Nexus/page.test.ts diff
+/** The writer takes a definition, not an id. The type only has to be one the value's kind can hold; the key is the label lowercased, so a write that reads the label lands on the wrong key. */
+const defOf = (id: string, type: PropertyType = 'select'): PropertyDefinition => {
+  const stem = id.replace(/^prop_/, '')
+  const label = stem.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + stem.slice(1)
+  return { id, label, key: label.toLowerCase(), type }
+}
```

##### Core/Properties/keyFormat.test.ts

```/Core/Properties/keyFormat.test.ts diff
@@ -0 +1 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import { DEFAULT_KEY_FORMAT, formatKey, isKeyFormat, KEY_FORMATS, spellingsOf } from './keyFormat'
+
+const unchangedBy = (word: string) => KEY_FORMATS.filter((f) => formatKey(word, f) === word)
+
+describe('keyFormat', () => {
+  it('lists the ten formats with Match Title first and as the default', () => {
+    expect(KEY_FORMATS).toEqual([
+      'Match Title',
+      'lowercase',
+      'UPPERCASE',
+      'kebab-case',
+      'PascalCase',
+      'camelCase',
+      'snake_case',
+      'Train-Case',
+      'UPPER_SNAKE_CASE',
+      'UPPER-KEBAB-CASE',
+    ])
+    expect(DEFAULT_KEY_FORMAT).toBe('Match Title')
+  })
+
+  it('writes the label as it is without a format', () => {
+    expect(formatKey('Due Date')).toBe('Due Date')
+  })
+
+  it('keeps punctuation inside its word and lowercase keeps separators', () => {
+    expect(formatKey('v5.0', 'kebab-case')).toBe('v5.0')
+    expect(formatKey('J. Crew', 'kebab-case')).toBe('j.-crew')
+    expect(formatKey('New Property', 'lowercase')).toBe('new property')
+    expect(formatKey('Due-Date', 'lowercase')).toBe('due-date')
+  })
+
+  it('splits at humps and converts its own output to itself', () => {
+    expect(formatKey('IPhone', 'kebab-case')).toBe('i-phone')
+    expect(formatKey('XMLHttp', 'kebab-case')).toBe('xml-http')
+    expect(formatKey('iPhone 17', 'PascalCase')).toBe('IPhone17')
+    expect(formatKey('IPhone17', 'PascalCase')).toBe('IPhone17')
+    expect(formatKey('A B Test', 'camelCase')).toBe('aBTest')
+    expect(formatKey('aBTest', 'camelCase')).toBe('aBTest')
+  })
+
+  it('cases each word of URL Slug per convention', () => {
+    expect(formatKey('URL Slug', 'PascalCase')).toBe('UrlSlug')
+    expect(formatKey('URL Slug', 'camelCase')).toBe('urlSlug')
+    expect(formatKey('URL Slug', 'Train-Case')).toBe('Url-Slug')
+    expect(formatKey('URL Slug', 'snake_case')).toBe('url_slug')
+    expect(formatKey('URL Slug', 'UPPER_SNAKE_CASE')).toBe('URL_SLUG')
+    expect(formatKey('URL Slug', 'UPPER-KEBAB-CASE')).toBe('URL-SLUG')
+  })
+
+  it('leaves Red, RED, and green unchanged under exactly the formats that could produce them', () => {
+    expect(unchangedBy('Red')).toEqual(['Match Title', 'PascalCase', 'Train-Case'])
+    expect(unchangedBy('RED')).toEqual([
+      'Match Title',
+      'UPPERCASE',
+      'UPPER_SNAKE_CASE',
+      'UPPER-KEBAB-CASE',
+    ])
+    expect(unchangedBy('green')).toEqual([
+      'Match Title',
+      'lowercase',
+      'kebab-case',
+      'camelCase',
+      'snake_case',
+    ])
+  })
+
+  it('writes a snake_case key from a spaced label', () => {
+    expect(formatKey('Heading Icon Hidden', 'snake_case')).toBe('heading_icon_hidden')
+  })
+
+  it('cases ß, ligatures, final sigma, and NFD labels correctly', () => {
+    expect(formatKey('Straße', 'UPPERCASE')).toBe('STRASSE')
+    expect(formatKey('Straße', 'lowercase')).toBe('straße')
+    expect(formatKey('ﬁle Name', 'Train-Case')).toBe('File-Name')
+    expect(formatKey('File-Name', 'Train-Case')).toBe('File-Name')
+    expect(formatKey('ΑΣ Σ', 'PascalCase')).toBe('ΑςΣ')
+    expect(formatKey('CaféBar'.normalize('NFD'), 'kebab-case')).toBe('café-bar')
+    expect(formatKey('CaféBar'.normalize('NFD'), 'kebab-case')).toBe(
+      formatKey('CaféBar'.normalize('NFC'), 'kebab-case'),
+    )
+  })
+
+  it('round-trips J. Crew under PascalCase to a different key', () => {
+    expect(formatKey('J. Crew', 'PascalCase')).toBe('J.Crew')
+    expect(formatKey('J.Crew', 'PascalCase')).toBe('J.crew')
+  })
+
+  it('drops an all-separator label to empty only where separators are dropped', () => {
+    expect(formatKey('---', 'kebab-case')).toBe('')
+    expect(formatKey('---', 'lowercase')).toBe('---')
+  })
+
+  it('recognizes only listed formats', () => {
+    expect(isKeyFormat('kebab-case')).toBe(true)
+    expect(isKeyFormat('Kebab')).toBe(false)
+    expect(isKeyFormat(undefined)).toBe(false)
+  })
+
+  it('spells a label under every format, Match Title first', () => {
+    expect(spellingsOf('Value One')).toEqual([
+      'Value One',
+      'value one',
+      'VALUE ONE',
+      'value-one',
+      'ValueOne',
+      'valueOne',
+      'value_one',
+      'Value-One',
+      'VALUE_ONE',
+      'VALUE-ONE',
+    ])
+  })
+})
```

```/Core/Properties/optionOps.test.ts diff
+  const col = made.value.path
```

```/Core/Properties/restoreValue.test.ts diff
+import { mkdir, readFile, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import { join } from '../Paths/posix'

+import { createContextGroup, createSpace } from '../Contexts/contextWrite'
+import { createFolderEntity } from '../Nexus/folderEntity'
+import { newId } from '../Nexus/ids'
+import { closeSession, openSession } from '../Nexus/session'
+import { dropLiveTree, refreshTree } from '../Nexus/liveTree'
+import { settledMutate } from '../Testing/settledMutate'
+import type { TrashDeps } from '../Trash/bundle'
+import type { PropertyDraft } from './properties'
+import type { PropertyValue } from './propertyValue'
+import { createProperty } from './registryProperty'
+import { assignProperty } from './assignment'
+
+const deps: TrashDeps = { trashMode: 'nexus', trashToSystem: async () => {} }
+const PAGE_ID = '01ARZ3NDEKPSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV'
+
+let root: string
+let pagePath: string
+let spacePath: string
+const ids: Record<string, string> = {}
+
+const property = async (over: Omit<PropertyDraft, 'id'>): Promise<string> => {
+  const made = await createProperty(root, { id: '', ...over })
+  if (!made.ok) throw new Error('setup')
+  return made.value.id
+}
+
+beforeEach(async () => {
+  root = tempRoot('pom-restore-')
+  await mkdir(contextsDir(root), { recursive: true })
+  await mkdir(nexusDir(root), { recursive: true })
+  await writeFile(join(nexusDir(root), 'nexus.json'), JSON.stringify({ id: 'nx', createdAt: 'x' }))
+  await writeFile(contextsRegistryFile(root), JSON.stringify({ contexts: [] }))
+  const groupId = newId()
+  const group = await createContextGroup(root, 'Projects', groupId)
+  if (!group.ok) throw new Error('setup')
+  const space = await createSpace(root, groupId, 'Pommora', newId())
+  if (!space.ok) throw new Error('setup')
+  spacePath = space.value.path
+  const col = await createFolderEntity(root, 'collection', 'Notes', newId())
+  if (!col.ok) throw new Error('setup')
+  pagePath = 'Notes/One.md'
+  ids.Tags = await property({
+    label: 'Tags',
+    type: 'multiSelect',
+    select_options: [
+      { key: 'Work', label: 'Work' },
+      { key: 'Life', label: 'Life' },
+    ],
+  })
+  ids.Status = await property({
+    label: 'Status',
+    type: 'select',
+    select_options: [
+      { key: 'Doing', label: 'Doing' },
+      { key: 'Done', label: 'Done' },
+    ],
+  })
+  ids.Count = await property({ label: 'Count', type: 'number' })
+  for (const id of Object.values(ids)) await assignProperty(root, col.value.path, id)
+  await writeFile(join(root, pagePath), `---\nID: ${PAGE_ID}\n---\nb\n`)
+  await openSession(root)
+})
+afterEach(async () => {
+  dropLiveTree()
+  closeSession()
+  await rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true })
+})
+
+interface Target {
+  path: () => string
+  seed: (key: string, raw: unknown, line: string) => Promise<void>
+  held: (key: string) => Promise<string | undefined>
+}
+
+const pageFile = () => join(root, pagePath)
+const sidecarFile = () => join(root, spacePath, '_space.json')
+const sidecar = () => readJsonAt(sidecarFile())
+
+// A page's key as its frontmatter lines spell it; a Space's as its JSON value.
+const page: Target = {
+  path: () => pagePath,
+  seed: async (_key, _raw, line) => {
+    await writeFile(pageFile(), `---\nID: ${PAGE_ID}\n${line}\n---\nb\n`)
+    await refreshTree(root)
+  },
+  held: async (key) => {
+    const lines = (await readFile(pageFile(), 'utf8')).split('\n')
+    const at = lines.findIndex((l) => l.startsWith(`${key}:`))
+    if (at < 0) return undefined
+    const end = lines.findIndex((l, i) => i > at && !l.startsWith('  '))
+    return lines.slice(at, end).join('\n')
+  },
+}
+const space: Target = {
+  path: () => spacePath,
+  seed: async (key, raw) => {
+    await writeFile(sidecarFile(), JSON.stringify({ ...(await sidecar()), [key]: raw }))
+    await refreshTree(root)
+  },
+  held: async (key) => {
+    const sc = await sidecar()
+    return Object.hasOwn(sc, key) ? JSON.stringify(sc[key]) : undefined
+  },
+}
+
+const set = (target: Target, key: string, value: PropertyValue | null) =>
+  settledMutate(root, { op: 'setProperty', path: target.path(), propertyId: ids[key], value }, deps)
+const restore = (target: Target, key: string, held: unknown) =>
+  settledMutate(root, { op: 'restoreValue', path: target.path(), propertyId: ids[key], held }, deps)
+
+interface Case {
+  title: string
+  key: string
+  raw?: unknown
+  line?: string
+  value: PropertyValue | null
+  picked: { page: string | undefined; space: string | undefined }
+}
+
+const cases: Case[] = [
+  {
+    title: 'a Multi-Select holding a word in another casing, picked, restores the word',
+    key: 'Tags',
+    raw: ['work'],
+    line: 'Tags:\n  - work',
+    value: { kind: 'multiSelect', value: ['Work'] },
+    picked: { page: 'Tags:\n  - Work\n  - work', space: '["Work","work"]' },
+  },
+  {
+    title: 'a Multi-Select an unpick cleared restores its option and its foreign word',
+    key: 'Tags',
+    raw: ['Work', 'ideas'],
+    line: 'Tags:\n  - Work\n  - ideas',
+    value: { kind: 'multiSelect', value: [] },
+    picked: { page: undefined, space: undefined },
+  },
+  {
+    title: 'a Select holding a word in another casing, picked, restores the word',
+    key: 'Status',
+    raw: 'done',
+    line: 'Status: done',
+    value: { kind: 'select', value: 'Doing' },
+    picked: { page: 'Status:\n  - Doing', space: '["Doing"]' },
+  },
+  {
+    title: 'a Number holding text it can’t read, set, restores the text',
+    key: 'Count',
+    raw: 'abc',
+    line: 'Count: abc',
+    value: { kind: 'number', value: 5 },
+    picked: { page: 'Count: 5', space: '5' },
+  },
+  {
+    title: 'a Multi-Select given another option restores its one option',
+    key: 'Tags',
+    raw: ['Work'],
+    line: 'Tags:\n  - Work',
+    value: { kind: 'multiSelect', value: ['Work', 'Life'] },
+    picked: { page: 'Tags:\n  - Work\n  - Life', space: '["Work","Life"]' },
+  },
+  {
+    title: 'a key the file didn’t hold, set, leaves on the restore',
+    key: 'Count',
+    value: { kind: 'number', value: 5 },
+    picked: { page: 'Count: 5', space: '5' },
+  },
+]
+
+describe.each([
+  ['a page', page, 'page'],
+  ['a Space', space, 'space'],
+] as const)('a restore on %s writes back exactly what the file held', (_, target, kind) => {
+  it.each(cases.map((c) => [c.title, c] as const))('%s', async (_, {
+    key,
+    raw,
+    line,
+    value,
+    picked,
+  }) => {
+    const held = raw === undefined ? undefined : kind === 'page' ? line : JSON.stringify(raw)
+    if (raw !== undefined) await target.seed(key, raw, line ?? '')
+    expect(await target.held(key)).toBe(held)
+    expect((await set(target, key, value)).ok).toBe(true)
+    expect(await target.held(key)).toBe(picked[kind])
+    expect((await restore(target, key, raw)).ok).toBe(true)
+    expect(await target.held(key)).toBe(held)
+  })
+})
```
